text: Cute!. Bought these as Christmas gifts and they were a hit. I added one to our bathroom as well. Works great and easy to clean. I like that these are smaller for small areas like the bathroom.

product_metadata.title: MyGift Silver Ceramic Essential Oil Burner Tealight Candle Holder Decorative Aroma Diffuser, Set of 2
features: Set of 2 round silver tone essential oil warmers with star and moon cutout design, perfect for adding scent and glow to any space
Add essential or perfumed oil into the shallow bowl at the top of each candle holder to be heated by the candle below and create a fragrant atmosphere
Insert a tealight into the large opening in the back to create light and heat to warm the oils above
Silver tone and star and moon cutouts create beautiful shadows and shine adding to the calming ambiance of any spa, meditation, message or bathroom settings
Approximate Dimensions: Overall - 3.3 H x 2.9 Diameter: Candle Opening - 2.0 W x 1.4 H (in inches)
description: Create a warm and relaxing mood that will turn your home into a place for you to unwind and de-stress with these set of 2 small silver tone ceramic oil warmer candle holders. Simply place a tea light into the large opening in the back and fill the top small burner bowl with your favorite scented or essential oil. Once the candle is lit and the oil warms, the lovely fragrance and soft candle light will bring a relaxing ambiance to your home, spa, meditation, message or bathroom settings. The silver metallic finish brings a shiny modern touch to any décor while the cutout moon and stars shapes provide charming decoration and beautiful glow and shadows when in use. Bring style, warm candlelight, and pleasing aroma to any space with this set of 2 silver ceramic tealight holders with top scented oil warmer burner bowls and decorative star and moon cutout designs. **Candles and oils not included**
Approximate Dimensions: Overall - 3.3 H x 2.9 Diameter: Candle Opening - 2.0 W x 1.4 H (in inches)
